actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatKeyServices.find#ChatDevices').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors, deviceList: out.deviceList || []})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatKeyServices.get#ChatKeySettings').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors, verifiedDevicesOnly: !!out.verifiedDevicesOnly})
